notes: The three separate groups are intentional, not a real connectivity problem, so I kept them. The booklet builds three separate models: the theater (b1-b139, steps 1-30), a black car (b140-b151, pages 22-23) and a blue truck (b152-b164, pages 24-25). The final page shows the two vehicles standing beside the theater and not attached to it. Adding joins between them would invent connections the manual does not have.
Built from the 164-piece parts list. Ids b1-b164 follow build order.
The 'x2/x4' sub-steps (stacked plate pairs, lamps, wheels) are written out as individual parts and edges instead of repeats, because each copy has its own id and a different attachment point.
The pictures are small, so exact stud positions are approximate. Most edges have null ports. Which piece sits on which neighbour is my best reading of the images.

The manual's element numbers differ from the supplied parts list in a few places (for example the 2x2 tile and 2x4 tile in step 2 and step 25). I followed the supplied list. b3 is the Dark Blue 2x4 tile (lego-87079) and b116 is the 2x2 tile (lego-3068b).
Wheels are joined to the wheel-holder plates (lego-4081b) with null ports and revolute freedom. The catalogue has no wheel-holder or axle ports.
The street lamp (b134-b139) is placed on green plate b20. The cone (b137) goes on the brown round plate b33 on green plate b21.
